tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud & E-Commerce Specialist – Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and agile techno-functional analysis. Proven record of designing data pipelines, API migrations and supporting large-scale e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: IT Applications Manager (m/w/d) - SAP / E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by The People Finding Company’s vision to shape the next generation of connected home appliances. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have delivered robust e-commerce platforms that scale globally.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), delivering product, catalog and pricing modules that support large-scale e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and engineered API migrations, while creating PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) that keep product data synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Analysis
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role I gathered requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications, and translated business needs into SAP Commerce solutions, collaborating with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Agile DevOps Delivery
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), used Docker/Kubernetes for cloud deployments and led performance tuning of SQL queries, ensuring stable production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your digital platform roadmap.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als IT Applications Manager (m/w/d) - SAP / E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die Vision der People Finding Company, vernetzte Hausgeräte der Zukunft zu gestalten, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich skalierbare E-Commerce-Plattformen für ein globales Umfeld realisiert.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, darunter Produkt-, Katalog- und Preis-Module für großflächige E-Commerce-Operationen.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationskenntnisse
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Web-Services bereitgestellt, API-Migrationen durchgeführt und PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) aufgebaut, um Produktdaten über globale Kanäle zu synchronisieren.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Business-Analyse
bullets.text: In einer techno-funktionalen Rolle habe ich Anforderungen erfasst, User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und Geschäftsanforderungen in SAP-Commerce-Lösungen übersetzt, dabei mit internationalen Stakeholdern zusammengearbeitet.

bullets.label: Agile DevOps-Umsetzung
bullets.text: Ich habe CI/CD-Deployments auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) durchgeführt, Docker/Kubernetes für Cloud-Deployments genutzt und SQL-Abfragen optimiert, um stabile Produktionsunterstützung zu gewährleisten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Gerne erläutere ich, wie ich Ihre digitale Plattform-Roadmap voranbringen kann.

tailoring.why_company: The People Finding Company’s focus on connected home appliances aligns perfectly with my experience delivering integrated e-commerce solutions that bridge hardware data and digital storefronts. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce, API integration and techno-functional expertise to accelerate your platform modernization and support the global rollout across 100 markets.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help shape the digital future of connected home appliances by leveraging my SAP Commerce and integration expertise to deliver robust, scalable e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years of experience in large-scale e-commerce integrations. I’m very interested in the IT Applications Manager role at The People Finding Company and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the IT Applications Manager (SAP / E-Commerce) position. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong API integration skills and a proven techno-functional background. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.

Kind regards
